en.askFailed: The question could not be answered
en.autoFixTitle: Watch this pull request for review comments and failing checks, hand them to Claude to fix and push until everything passes; uncheck to stop.
en.cleanupDescription: Remove the worktree and local branch, then archive the workspace sessions and delete the workspace; a plain checkout switches back to the base branch and deletes the merged branch.
en.cleanupDescriptionUnmerged: This worktree has no pull request. Remove the worktree and local branch, then archive the workspace sessions and delete the workspace; refused while the branch holds commits that are on no remote.
en.conflictAbortConfirm: Press "Abort {operation}" again to confirm: work done during the {operation} is discarded.
en.conflictDescription: The {operation} is unfinished. Resolve the conflicts and continue, or abort to return to the state before it.
en.conflictFiles: These files conflict and must be resolved and staged:
en.conflictReady: Every conflict is resolved. The operation can continue.
en.defaultPermissionModeEffect: The Claude Code permission mode a new Claude session starts in; DSH's access preset is moved onto the sandbox that mode needs as the session is created. A session you have since changed with the composer's own selector runs its own choice. A sandbox switched natively (/permission) wins over the mode, and auto yields to Default on a model that cannot run it. Changes apply to sessions created from then on.
en.description: DSH uses the local Claude Code and preserves its agent loop, tools, CLAUDE.md, Skills, Hooks, and MCP configuration.
en.diagnosticsBody: Check the Claude Code executable, authentication, protocol handshake, and current process configuration.
en.diffCommitMessageHint: Start with a short summary. Add details after a blank line.
en.diffConfirmDescription: Confirm the repository snapshot and Git operation.
en.diffEmpty: No tracked file changes to display
en.diffGeneratingMessage: Suggesting a commit message. It only fills the fields you leave empty.
en.diffMergeDescription: Merge the pull request for this branch with the selected method.
en.diffPrCompleted: Created the pull request — open it from the repository bar.
en.diffPushDescription: Push local commits to the remote branch.
en.diffRevertAllConfirm: Discard the uncommitted changes in all {count} files? New files are deleted. This cannot be undone.
en.diffRevertFileConfirm: Discard the uncommitted changes to {path}? This cannot be undone.
en.diffRevertNothing: There are no uncommitted changes to revert; these are already committed.
en.diffTruncated: The diff exceeds the safe display limit. Use the terminal to inspect the complete content.
en.diffUpdateBranch_merge: Merge origin/{base} into the current branch
en.diffUpdateBranch_rebase: Rebase onto origin/{base} (rewrites history, pushes with --force-with-lease)
en.diffUpdateBranchConflicts: The update left conflicts in these files:
en.diffUpdateBranchDescription: Update the current branch from origin/{base} and push; hand any conflicts to Claude.
en.globalSettingsBody: Modify supported Claude Code and plugin settings while preserving every other field.
en.globalSettingsNewSession: Changes apply only to new Claude sessions.
en.heroBatchStarted: Kicked off {count} tickets, each in its own worktree session
en.heroTicketSearch: Search tickets or enter a key…
en.idleTimeoutEffect: The idle timeout applies after the next completed turn. Blank or invalid values are rejected.
en.jiraBody: Connect Jira Cloud to start new sessions from a ticket: the branch is named after the ticket key, the composer is seeded with the ticket brief, and the ticket is assigned to you once the worktree exists.
en.jiraTokenHelp: Create an API token at Atlassian
en.linkedRepositoryPrompt: The following concerns the linked repository at {root} (branch {branch}), not this session's own checkout.
en.maxProcessesEffect: Saving immediately reclaims excess idle processes; running processes converge after they finish. New sessions wait for capacity while every process is busy. Blank or invalid values are rejected.
en.permissionBypassDescription: Claude Code will run file edits and commands without asking for approval.
en.permissionModeAcceptEditsHint: File edits go through on their own; commands still ask
en.permissionModeAutoHint: Claude Code's classifier approves on your behalf and asks you only when unsure
en.permissionModeAutoUnsupported: The current model does not support auto mode
en.permissionModeDefaultHint: Every file edit and command asks first
en.permissionModeDontAskHint: Anything not pre-approved is refused instead of asked about
en.permissionModeFailed: Could not switch the permission mode: {message}
en.permissionModeHostKept: DSH kept its own access preset; Claude still runs the chosen mode
en.permissionModeLocked: The permission mode cannot change while a turn is running
en.permissionModePlanHint: Read-only exploration; the plan comes back for your approval before anything runs
en.permissionSelectorEffect: Plugin: the composer shows this plugin's selector with every Claude Code permission mode, and new sessions start in the default mode below. DSH native: the Host's own read-only / workspace-write / full-access selector stays, and the mode follows the sandbox alone (read-only is Plan, workspace-write is Accept edits, full access is Bypass); per-session choices and the default mode are not consulted. Takes effect immediately; a running turn keeps its mode.
en.planEmpty: This session has no plan to read yet.
en.planFeedbackFailed: The notes could not be sent. Try again.
en.planNoteHint: Select a passage above to quote it
en.planNotePlaceholder: What should change? Enter files a note, ⌘/Ctrl+Enter sends
en.planNoteQuotedPlaceholder: What should change about the selected passage?
en.planPendingHint: Approve or reject this plan in the DSH approval dialog.
en.planSettled: This plan was already decided in the approval dialog; the notes were not sent.
en.planUsageBody: Utilization windows for the signed-in Claude subscription, from Claude Code's /usage data. Refreshes whenever a session goes idle, and on demand.
en.planUsageNever: No usage data yet — run a turn or refresh.
en.planUsageUnavailable: This account has no plan limits (API key, Bedrock, and Vertex sessions are not rate limited by a subscription).
en.pluginUpdateBody: Check npm for new releases. Only a uniquely identified npm installation can update in place; local development links are never replaced.
en.prCommentsSend: Have Claude address the GitHub pull request comments
en.presetClaudeDescription: Use the local Claude Code as the complete agent runtime inside DSH.
en.presetHeaderHint: The agent preset this session runs
en.promptSaveExists: A prompt with that name already exists. Try another.
en.proseEffect: Gives headings, bold, italics, inline code, list markers, quotes and links their own colours, and paints the code block on a dark outlined surface. This overrides the Claude-desktop palette this package matches by default. Only applies under the plugin renderer, and takes effect immediately rather than on the next turn.
en.rendererEffect: The plugin renderer keeps this package’s own transcript: interleaved prose, grouped tool cards, and activity rows. The DSH native renderer hands the same turn to DSH itself — prose as ordinary assistant text blocks, thinking as reasoning blocks, and root Claude tools mirrored into native tool cards. A change applies from the next turn; turns already recorded keep the renderer they were recorded with and are not redrawn.
en.repositoryBranchRefreshStale: The Host process is still running the previous plugin build, which has no refresh route. Restart DSH and try again.
en.repositoryDraftTransferFailed: Draft attachments could not be moved to the worktree session.
en.repositoryLinked: Linked repository: changed by this session
en.repositoryNoPr: No pull request for this branch
en.repositoryOpen: Show repository and pull request details
en.repositoryProgress_summarizing: Naming the branch after the request
en.repositorySessionUnavailable: The target session could not be prepared.
en.restartRequired: Restart DeepSeek Harness to load the updated plugin.
en.reviewCommentFailed: The comment could not be saved.
en.reviewCommentsSendDraft: Please address the attached review comments.
en.reviewThreadReplyFailed: The reply could not be posted.
en.reviewThreadReplyPlaceholder: Reply to this comment; type @ to mention someone
en.reviewThreadResolveFailed: The thread could not be updated.
en.rewindBusy: This session is running; wait for the turn to finish before rewinding.
en.rewindDescription: This removes the message and the {count} entries below it, and returns Claude to the context it had before you sent it. This cannot be undone.
en.rewindFilesUnavailable: The conversation was rewound, but the files were left alone: that turn recorded no working-tree snapshot.
en.rewindHint: The removed entries are hidden from this session and Claude forgets them; the message text goes back to the composer so you can edit and resend it.
en.rewindRestoreFiles: Also put the files back to where this turn found them
en.rewindRestoreFilesHint: The removed entries are hidden from this session and Claude forgets them, and the checkout returns to the state this turn started from — files created since are deleted, changed files are restored, and files ignored by .gitignore are left alone. The message text goes back to the composer so you can edit and resend it.
en.rewindStale: The Host process is still running the previous plugin build, which has no rewind route. Restart DSH and try again.
en.securityBody: Claude tool permissions are decided through the DSH approval UI. This version does not claim kernel-level write isolation for ~/.claude or paths outside the workspace.
en.teammateGone: This teammate is no longer on the task board
en.title: Claude Code
en.updateNotChecked: Updates have not been checked yet.
en.updateState_linked: Updated from the linked source checkout
en.updateState_unavailable: The active DSH profile cannot be identified safely
en.updateState_unsupported: This installation source cannot update automatically
en.worktreeBranchPrefixEffect: Prefix changes apply to subsequently generated Worktree branches. Explicit full branch names remain unchanged.
